Man Stabbed Near Mahim Station Following Altercation

A man was chased and stabbed near Mahim Station in Mumbai following a dispute. The altercation reportedly stemmed from an incident involving damage to a mobile phone. Police have apprehended an accused in connection with the assault, while another remains at large.
